paite: Ka hai deuhna uah noute'n Pathian ah na hon thuak theih uh ka ut hi. Ahi, thuak leng na hon thuak theita uhi!
heading: Paul Leh Sawltak Takloute
english: I wish that you would bear with me in a little foolishness, but indeed you do bear with me.

paite: Pathian hazatna, thikthuse khop in ahi nou ka hon hazat; Khrist kiang a nungak siangthou bang a ka hon piaktheihna ding in, pasal khat ka hon hawisak hi.
english: For I am jealous over you with a godly jealousy. For I promised you in marriage to one husband, that I might present you as a pure virgin to Christ.

paite: Himahleh gul in azuau pil a Evi akhem bang in, Khrist lam a takna leh sianthouna a kipan bangchi hiam in na lungsim uh ahihse kha ding, chih ka lauthawng hi.
english: But I am afraid that somehow, as the serpent deceived Eve in his craftiness, so your minds might be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.

paite: Khattei hong pai a Jesu dang, athu ka gen ngei louh uh, agen a, kha lamdang na muh ngei louh uh leh tanchinhoih lamdang na san ngei louh uh, na pom pah un kipe baih lua na himah kei ding ua hia!
english: For if he who comes preaches another Jesus whom we didn’t preach, or if you receive a different spirit which you didn’t receive, or a different “good news” which you didn’t accept, you put up with that well enough.

paite: Hiai Sawltaklian thuneipen na chihte uh sang in bang lam peuh ah niamzawkna nei in ka kigingta kei hi.
english: For I reckon that I am not at all behind the very best apostles.

paite: Thugen lam ah pau zatsiam kei mah leng theihna ah zaw huchibang ka hi kei uhi; huai noute kiang ah bang lam peuh leh thil tengteng ah ka kilangsak uhi.
english: But though I am unskilled in speech, yet I am not unskilled in knowledge. No, in every way we have been revealed to you in all things.

paite: Ahihkeileh, Pathian tanchinhoih athawn lel a ka hon hilh ziak a tawisan a na omtheihna ding ua ka kihihniam in thil ka hihkhial a hia?
english: Or did I commit a sin in humbling myself that you might be exalted, because I preached to you God’s Good News free of charge?

paite: Na nna uh ka septheihna ding in midangte a kipan huhna la in, saptuam pawl dangte ka lok ahi.
english: I robbed other assemblies, taking wages from them that I might serve you.

paite: Huan na kiang ua ka om a, ka taksap lai in, kuamah ka hon hihbuai kei a; unau Masidonia gam a kipan a hong paite'n ka taksap awng ahong huksak ngal ua; bangkim ah noumau hihbuai lou in ka kibawl bang in, ka kibawl zel lai ding hi.
english: When I was present with you and was in need, I wasn’t a burden on anyone, for the brothers, when they came from Macedonia, supplied the measure of my need. In everything I kept myself from being burdensome to you, and I will continue to do so.

paite: Khrist thutak kei mah a a-om bang in, hiai ka kisuanna zaw Akhaia gam lam ah hihdaih in a-om kei ding.
english: As the truth of Christ is in me, no one will stop me from this boasting in the regions of Achaia.

paite: Bangziak in? K'on it louh ziak hia? Pathian in ka hon it lam athei hi.
english: Why? Because I don’t love you? God knows.

paite: Huan anasep uh kisaktheihpih a, kou sep bangbang a sem kichite kichihna ka bulkalh theihna ding in ka sep tuh ka sem zom zel ding hi.
english: But what I do, that I will continue to do, that I may cut off opportunity from those who desire an opportunity, that in which they boast, they may be recognized just like us.

paite: Mi huchibangte zaw Khrist sawltak akibawltawm a, sawltak takloute, nasemmi, mikhem hatte ahi uhi.
english: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as Christ’s apostles.

paite: Huai ahihleh alamdang kei; Setan hial leng vak sawltak in akibawltawm nak ahi.
english: And no wonder, for even Satan masquerades as an angel of light.

paite: Huaiziak in anasemte leng diktatna nasemmi in kibawltawm mah le uh thillamdang ahi kei; huaite tawpna zaw athilhih bang zel un ahi ding hi.
english: It is no great thing therefore if his servants also masquerade as servants of righteousness, whose end will be according to their works.

paite: Ka chi nawn ahi, kuamah in mihai in hon sep kei uhen; himahleh na hon seh vanglak uleh, ke'n leng neuchik bek a ka kisaktheih sam theihna ding in mihai bangtak in hon pom un.
heading: Sawltak Hihna Ziak A Paul Thuakna
english: I say again, let no one think me foolish. But if so, yet receive me as foolish, that I also may boast a little.

paite: Ka gen zaw Toupa thuneihna in ka gen kei a, ka kisaktheihna mihai bangtak in ka gen zaw ahi.
english: That which I speak, I don’t speak according to the Lord, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of boasting.

paite: Mi tampite'n khovel thilte akisaktheihpih ziak un kei leng ka hong kisathei sam ding hi.
english: Seeing that many boast after the flesh, I will also boast.

paite: Nou bel mipil na hih ziak un mihaite lungkimtak in na thuakzou zel uhi.
english: For you bear with the foolish gladly, being wise.

paite: Mi sal a hon bawlte, hon negaite, nuamtak hon sa a na tung ua kiliansak leh na mai ua hon bengte na thuak thei zel ngal ua.
english: For you bear with a man if he brings you into bondage, if he devours you, if he takes you captive, if he exalts himself, or if he strikes you on the face.

paite: Kisitna dan in ka gen ahi, huchi dia zaw hat lou lua mah kei ve ua!
english: To my shame, I speak as though we had been weak. Yet in whatever way anyone is bold (I speak in foolishness), I am bold also.

paite: Amaute Hebru mi ahi uhia? Kei leng ka hi. Israel mi ahi uhia? Kei leng ka hi. Abraham suante ahi uhia? Kei leng ka hi.
english: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they the offspring of Abraham? So am I.

paite: Khrist nasemte ahi uhia? Mihai bang in gen taleng, ka hi sem; sepgimna ah thupi sem in, suangkul tanna ah bang thupi sem in, vuakna ah bang akan-aval in, sih lauhuaina tamveipi ka tuak hi.
english: Are they servants of Christ? (I speak as one beside himself.) I am more so: in labors more abundantly, in prisons more abundantly, in stripes above measure, and in deaths often.

paite: Judate lak ah vuakna khatvei a sawmli ching lou ngavei ka tuak hi.
english: Five times I received forty stripes minus one from the Jews.

paite: Thumvei chiang a khet in ka om a, khatvei suang a den in ka om hi, thumvei longsiatna ka tuak a, zan khat leh ni khat tuipi ah taihmang in ka om hi.
english: Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I was stoned. Three times I suffered shipwreck. I have been a night and a day in the deep.

paite: Khualzinna ah tamveipi, luite lak ah lauhuai, suamhatte lak ah lauhuai, ka chipihte lak ah lauhuai, Zentelte lak ah lauhuai, khopi ah lauhuai, gamdai ah lauhuai, tuipi ah lauhuai, unau takloute lak ah lauhuai;
english: I have been in travels often, perils of rivers, perils of robbers, perils from my countrymen, perils from the Gentiles, perils in the city, perils in the wilderness, perils in the sea, perils among false brothers;

paite: septawlna leh sepgimna, ihmutmohna ah tamveipi, gilkial leh dangtakna ah, an ngawlna ah tamveipi, khosik leh vuaktang a omnate.
english: in labor and travail, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, and in cold and nakedness.

paite: Huan hiaite ban a kigen lou saptuam pawl tengteng ka ngaihtuahna niteng a hon delh gige leng a-om hi.
english: Besides those things that are outside, there is that which presses on me daily: anxiety for all the assemblies.

paite: Kua ahia zawngkhal a om a, ke'n ka zawnkhalpih louh? Kua ahia khelhna a puksia a, ke'n ka lunggimpih louh?
english: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is caused to stumble, and I don’t burn with indignation?

paite: Suang ding ka hih vanglakleh ka hatlouhna lam thilte ahi ka suan ding.
english: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that concern my weakness.

paite: Tangtawn a phat tak, Toupa Jesu' Pathian leh Pa in zuau ka genlouhdan athei hi.
english: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus Christ, he who is blessed forever more, knows that I don’t lie.

paite: Damaskas ah kumpipa Aretas nuai a gam-ukpa'n hon man ding in Damaskas khopi avengsak a;
english: In Damascus the governor under King Aretas guarded the Damascenes’ city, desiring to arrest me.

paite: himahleh kulhbaang tohlet ah bawm in hon khaikhia ua, huchi in akhut a kipan ka suakta hi.
english: I was let down in a basket through a window by the wall, and escaped his hands.
